summary: Kernel-checked conjugate-heat layer: ConjugateHeatData is the backward heat operator with scalar-curvature term (box* = -d_t - Delta + R) over a stated metric-flow interface (L2 pairing, Laplace-Beltrami operator, scalar-curvature multiplication, Green boundary form, and the stated volume variation d_t dV = -R dV); the formal adjointness of the heat and conjugate-heat operators is proved at the algebraic level under an explicit integration-by-parts certificate; a discrete conjugate-heat slab monotonicity toy is proved with a telescoping energy argument; and the conjugate heat kernel existence theorem is a state-only Prop with six named blockers and seven exact missing mathlib dependencies. No sorry, axiom, unsafe, native_decide, or proof_wanted.

fields: volumeVariation : Jet F -> Jet F -> R
volumeVariation_apply : volumeVariation j k = pairing j.2 k.1 + pairing j.1 k.2 - pairing (scalarMul j.1) k.1
laplacian_ibp : pairing (laplacian u) v - pairing u (laplacian v) = boundaryForm u v
MetricFlowInterface.metric_flow_statement: d_t dV = -R dV, i.e. d_t<pairing> = <d_t u, v> + <u, d_t v> - <R u, v>

fields: forwardHeat : Jet F ->l F (H = d_t - Delta)
backwardHeat : Jet F ->l F (box* = -d_t - Delta + R)
forwardHeat_apply : forwardHeat j = j.2 - laplacian j.1
backwardHeat_apply : backwardHeat j = -j.2 - laplacian j.1 + scalarMul j.1

green_identities.pairingOn: pairingOn m S u v = sum over x in S of m x * u x * v x
green_identities.laplaceBeltrami: mass-normalized graph Laplacian; an edge contributes w e * (u (tgt e) - u x) at its tail and w e * (u (src e) - u x) at its head
green_identities.dirichletForm: sum over interior edges of w e * (u (tgt e) - u (src e)) * (v (tgt e) - v (src e))
green_identities.boundaryPair: explicit boundary contribution of the edges crossing dS
green_identities.boundaryForm: boundaryPair u v - boundaryPair v u (antisymmetric)
green_identities.green_first: pairingOn m S (laplaceBeltrami D w m u) v = -dirichletForm D w S u v + boundaryPair D w S u v
green_identities.green_second: pairingOn m S (laplaceBeltrami D w m u) v - pairingOn m S (laplaceBeltrami D w m v) u = boundaryForm D w S u v

formal_adjointness.statement: pairing (forwardHeat j) k.1 - pairing j.1 (backwardHeat k) = volumeVariation j k - boundaryForm j.1 k.1
formal_adjointness.reading: <H j, k> - <j, box* k> = d_t<j, k> - boundaryForm j k

instance.pairingOnLM: the region pairing as a bilinear form (restricted density massOn)
instance.metricFlowInterface: concrete MetricFlowInterface (V -> R); all ten fields discharged, laplacian_ibp is green_second

slab_monotonicity.step: conjugateHeatStep D w m R u = u + R • u - Δu
slab_monotonicity.energy: energy m u = sum over x of m x * (u x)^2
slab_monotonicity.one_step_statement: if 0 < m, 0 <= w, and 0 <= R then energy m u <= energy m (conjugateHeatStep D w m R u)
slab_monotonicity.slab_statement: for a slab Fin (n+1) whose successive slices are conjugate-heat steps, energy m (u 0) <= energy m (u (Fin.last n))
slab_monotonicity.decomposition: energy m (u + X) - energy m u = 2 * sum_x m x * u x * X x + sum_x m x * (X x)^2 with X = R • u - Δu

blocked.statement: for every compact Riemannian manifold (schematically a ConjugateHeatSpacetime satisfying IsRiemannianConjugateHeatSpacetime) and every terminal point (y0, t0), there exists a positive conjugate heat kernel solving box* K = 0 in the backward variables, normalized to integral 1, and converging to the Dirac delta at y0 as t -> t0^-
blocked.datum: ConjugateHeatSpacetime (volume, laplacian, scalarMul, backwardTimeDerivative) with conjugateHeat = -d_t - Delta + R
blocked.predicate: IsRiemannianConjugateHeatSpacetime (volume positive on nonempty opens, finite on compacts)

blockers.name: B-D7-CONJUGATE-HEAT-KERNEL-EXISTENCE
blockers.reason: no existence/uniqueness theory for the fundamental solution of a parabolic PDE; no parametrix, no Duhamel principle

blockers.name: B-D7-HEAT-KERNEL-MANIFOLD
blockers.reason: no heat kernel on Riemannian manifolds; no spectral theorem for the Laplace-Beltrami operator on a compact manifold

blockers.name: B-D7-DIRAC-DELTA
blockers.reason: no distribution theory or Dirac delta; the terminal condition cannot be stated as a distributional limit

blockers.name: B-D7-GAUSSIAN-BOUNDS
blockers.reason: no Gaussian bounds, no Li-Yau differential Harnack inequality

blockers.name: B-D7-RICCI-FLOW-SPACETIME
blockers.reason: no Ricci flow evolution equation, no spacetime manifold; the metric-flow interface is axiomatic

blockers.name: B-D7-PARABOLIC-MAXIMUM-PRINCIPLE
blockers.reason: no parabolic maximum principle, no backward uniqueness, no positivity-preserving semigroup theory
